Hi Marissa,

We signed up for the self-serve flow and are evaluating Redwood for a Dedicated deployment. We're particularly focused on throughput and tail latency since we're planning to serve real-time generation in our control loop. High-level details: estimated peak ~25 QPS, avg 60 tokens/response, target p95 latency <150ms for critical routes.

Would love to set up a demo with a focus on Dedicated sizing, kernel/quantization options, and typical latency/throughput tradeoffs. Prefer next week if possible — Tue/Wed mornings PT work best for our engineering team.

Happy to share a sample prompt set and recent perf runs if that helps.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of ML Engineering
